events.info: WYEP PRESENTS: https://wyep.org/Doors 7PM | Show 8PM$15 ADV | $20 DOS21+Laurel lowlifes are a five-member Appalachian Folk and Americana band based in Pittsburgh PA. Celebrated for their dynamic mix of raucous, foot stomping tunes and soul- stirring harmonies laced with a hint of country twang. Led by powerhouse vocalist Britt Haefeli and supported by Jack Hill (mandolin), David Powell (guitar), Dan Miller (upright bass) and Brenden Beaver (drums), they deliver high- energy performances that blend technical Americana roots with engaging folk storytelling. Theyve become a notable presence in the Pittsburgh music scene and continue to draw audiences with their tight arrangement and charismatic live showsBlooming Trio is a regional indie-folk singer-songwriter collaboration featuring Pennsylvania artist Skye Burkett and Ohio artists Bethany Joy and Josee McGee. They are known for their three-part vocal harmonies, acoustic and electric guitar, and keyboard arrangements blending folk, jazz, indie rock, and soul. Becks!

events.info: The Circus is here! You are invited to the most next-level family fun party on the planet. The all-new Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey is a non-stop celebration of jaw-dropping acts, laugh-out-loud fun, and memory-making moments you will not want to miss. Because this is not just about the action on stage, it is about the fun of sharing it with the people who matter most. From wide-eyed kids to seen-it-all grown-ups, we have got the WOW that will amaze them all. We have taken the biggest, boldest, most joy-sparking acts in the world and transformed them into a one-of-a-kind shared experience. So grab your crew and bring your biggest energy. The Greatest Show On Earth is throwing the worlds most unforgettable party and the best seat in the house is the one right next to you.

generalInfo.generalRule: No re-entry. No outside food and/or beverages. No pets (other than service animals). No bicycles or helmets. No weapons (regardless of permit). No umbrellas. No fireworks. events.info: Doors 6PM | Show 7PM$10 ADV | $15 DOS21+ Kara Frazier: Nashville-based singer-songwriter Kara Frazier is a rare artist who inhabits the space between eras. Originally from Jacksonville, FL, she has spent over a decade honing a sound that blends bluesy vocals with southern roots and a pop-soul feel. Emily Lehr & the Foxglove Fellows: A native West Virginian, Emily Lehr finds inspiration in the Appalachian traditions of communal music-making and raw lyricism. From cozy solo performances in the living room to lively shows with her band, the Foxglove Fellows, Emily connects with live audiences to bring her stories to life with friends old and new. Van Gilder: Van Gilder is a should and r&b inspired rock band based in Pittsburgh, PA. Founded in 2016 by longtime friends and collaborators Adelaide Estep and Connor Bragg, the band quickly found their sound by blending different influences to cultivate something unique.
